create_Mlp_class: create an Mlp class instance with specified in_features, hidden_features, and activation layer
build_Mlp_forward: build a forward pass through the Mlp class with a torch Tensor input
test_Mlp_dropout: test the Mlp class with configurable dropout rate for regularization
refactor_Mlp_bias: refactor the Mlp class to support optional bias in linear layers
review_Mlp_act_layer: review the Mlp class with customizable activation layer such as GELU or ReLU
